backOnItsLegs: Weather, particles, grade and shadows all read one agreed snapshot of time/sun/wind instead of each deriving their own.

Roadmap-to-Parity.md lists it as the spine four other passes wait on.

backOnItsLegs: One graded image: ToD and weather read as a single look rather than effects stacked on raw albedo.
note: Absorbs 14 V2 classes — more stranded V2 surface than any other single item. REVISED 2026-08-22 after reading the actual code: this is NOT building 14 things from scratch. The grade engine itself (grade-ops.js, grade-present.js, lut-cube.js) is real, tested, and already BUILT per Grade.md — only src/effects/grade/grade-pass.js#buildGradePass, the pass-graph WIRING, is a literal `throw new NotBuiltError(...)` stub. The work is wiring an existing engine into its own declared seam and verifying it actually covers the 14 absorbed behaviours, not authoring them. Everything in the cut list below is trapped behind this pass, so deciding what to drop here shrinks the verification job.
